name: AP_TAX_CODES_ALL
description:
AP_TAX_CODES_ALL contains information about the tax codes you define. You need one row for each tax code you want to use  when entering invoices. When you enter invoices, you can use a list of values to select a tax code defined in this table.
         
Your Oracle Payables application also uses TAX_RATE to  calculate use tax when you enter a taxable amount for an invoice. . This table corresponds to the Tax Codes window.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: A unique code that identifies the withholding tax rates applicable on supplier invoices.

columns.name: TAX_ID
columns.description: A unique identifier for withholding tax code.
